description: This file defines API routes for managing tags in a note-taking application, including listing, renaming, and deleting tags using FastAPI.

classes.name: TagRenameRequest
classes.description: Pydantic model for request payload when renaming a tag.

methods.name: List[TagOut] list_tags_endpoint(db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all tags.

methods.name: TagOut rename_tag_endpoint(tag_id: UUID, payload: TagRenameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to rename a specific tag by ID.

methods.name: dict delete_tag_endpoint(tag_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a tag by ID.

ctags.name: delete_tag_endpoint
ctags.pattern: /^def delete_tag_endpoint(tag_id: UUID, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) -> dict:$/

ctags.name: name
ctags.pattern: /^    name: str = Field(..., description="New tag name.")$/

ctags.name: rename_tag_endpoint
ctags.pattern: /^def rename_tag_endpoint(tag_id: UUID, payload: TagRenameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db)) /
ctags.signature: (tag_id: UUID, payload: TagRenameRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
